findings.summary: The acceptance self-check never executes a real cold-start run; it fabricates synthetic fixtures (fake `wiki@fake.md:N` anchors, hand-written report/evidence/events/launch.json in temp dirs) and only self-checks the judge against them. The spec's DoD「真机部署 + 端到端拿到结果 / 全新题目一条命令无人搀扶冷启动跑到带锚点可冷读报告」is therefore not actually demonstrated.

Criterion ① (发起命令原文在案) is not wired into the real pipeline: `record_launch_argv`/`launch.json` is produced only by self-check fixtures and tests, never by `run_research`/`run_research_ticket`/CLI. `judge_coldstart` also falls back `argv = load_launch_argv(run_root) or canonical_launch_argv(question)`, so a real run missing launch.json would auto-pass criterion ①, making the「无人搀扶 / 唯一入口」verification vacuous.
